findings.issue: Inside the actions loop, every paired preflop decision rebuilds `hand.seats.map(...)` and calls positionGroup(seats, button, userSeat), although the group depends only on the hand.
findings.evidence: `const seats = hand.seats.map((s) => s.seat); spots.set(j, { group: positionGroup(seats, button, userSeat), raisedBefore });` sits inside `for (const record of hand.actions)`.
findings.fix: Compute the group once, lazily, before the loop or on first use (e.g. `const group = positionGroup(hand.seats.map((s) => s.seat), button, userSeat)` hoisted, keeping it lazy if hands whose user is not dealt in must not throw), and use `{ group, raisedBefore }` in the loop.

findings.issue: The inserted clause leaves 'and is present exactly when `errors` is' attached to the preflop-spot clause, so the sentence reads as if the position group is 'present exactly when errors is'.
findings.evidence: "...when the session ends; a preflop decision's position group and whether someone raised before it come from the hand record's `seats`, `button` and `actions`, and is present exactly when `errors` is."
findings.fix: Split it into two sentences: "... when the session ends, and is present exactly when `errors` is. A preflop decision's position group and whether someone raised before it come from the hand record's `seats`, `button` and `actions`."

findings.issue: The 'user record that is not a blind' test repeats `userMade` in src/table/hand-record.ts:137-141 (the rule that defines the decision alignment A-3 relies on).
findings.evidence: `record.seat === userSeat && record.type !== 'small-blind' && record.type !== 'big-blind'` versus `userMade`'s identical filter.
findings.fix: Optional. Leave as is (leaks.ts must stay headless and hand-record.ts does not export it), or add a one-line comment pointing at userMade so the two rules stay in step.

summary: All SPEC items are implemented as specified and tested with assertions that would fail on a broken implementation. Focus checks: (1) positionGroup follows REQ-047.6/A-6 at 2,3,4,5,6,7,9,10 players, wrap-around and non-contiguous seats; heads-up gives button late / other blinds, matching the engine's heads-up blinds and positionOf. (2) raisedBefore = any earlier preflop record of type 'raise' (blinds excluded by type, own raise included), identical to situationOf's raise count in src/advice/preflop.ts.
